tool.title: Harness object model as PlantUML
tool.description: Draw the harness object model (Actor, Role, Skill, Process, Task, Todo, Bean, tests, schemas) with every attribute read from the schema behind it. Each relationship names the field that carries it, and the generator refuses to write if that field is gone.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if the committed diagram is stale. Needs the beans CLI; without it the result is could-not-check (exit 2).

outputs.name: diagram
outputs.description: The object-model diagram, in the instance's declared uml directory.
